name: trees-cut
note: The cut-out pass for the approved slice-B trees (elsinore, flatter; approved 2026-10-20): each redrawn on magenta from its own panel and cut by tools/art/cutout.js (n 1, silhouette fit with --fill above 1 so the canopy overhangs the tile) into public/assets/resources/. Owner 2026-10-23: put the approved trees in the game.

oak.prompt: REFERENCE: the attached panel on grass is this game's approved summer OAK TREE, a round layered green canopy on a short brown trunk, drawn in the game's style. Redraw the SAME tree, identical in every way: the same shape, size, colours, outline and shading, the same light from the upper left, the same soft contact shadow directly under the trunk. Change ONE thing only: the surroundings. There is NO grass, no ground, no grid: the tree stands on a flat, pure, solid magenta (#FF00FF) field that fills the whole image around it, nothing else drawn on it, no vignette, no texture, no gradient. The LAST attached image is a layout guide: a magenta field with a thin grid and a 1 x 1 box outlined in the middle, one board tile; the trunk's base stands on that box's bottom edge, centred, and the tree rises about two tiles tall above it, its canopy spreading a little past the box on each side, exactly as in the reference. Draw it there, nothing else, and leave every other pixel pure magenta. No letters anywhere.
